# anthropic_external_keys (Data Source)

Lists customer-managed encryption key registrations. Requires `admin_api_key` or `oauth_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_external_keys" "all" {}

output "attached_keys" {
  value = [for k in data.anthropic_external_keys.all.external_keys : k.id if k.attachment_type == "attached"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `external_keys` (Attributes List) External keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--external_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_keys`

Read-Only:

- `attachment_type` (String) `attached` or `unattached`.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `geo` (String) Geography.
- `id` (String) External key id.
- `key_name` (String) Key name (gcp, azure).
- `kms_arn` (String) AWS KMS key ARN (aws).
- `provider_type` (String) `aws`, `gcp` or `azure`.
- `region` (String) AWS region (aws).
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant id (azure).
- `vault_uri` (String) Key Vault URI (azure).
